blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.
blocks.zh: 代表-空间基因模型,如代表自动编码器(RAEs),主要为加快培训,提高样本忠诚度而利用预先训练的视觉基础模型(VFM). 然而VFM不仅仅是重建活化剂,因为它们的特点是丰富的代表空间,高度有条理,线性可读. 我们观察到,这消除了后热导流的关键障碍:通过期望线性,一个适用于理想的德诺瓦人预测的清洁探测器在任何噪声水平上都得出探测器分数的准确后平均值. 我们称之为"语义平均空间"的这种制度,将语义引导变成了一个贝叶斯线性反向问题,绕过了培训时间调节的需要. 有了这个基础,我们提出LISM, 语义平均空间线性引导的统一框架. 为了验证这一框架,我们开发并调整了不同的解析器,并根据它们如何估计探测器-空间不确定性和如何通过表示来传播校正。 此外,我们提出Fit-Path,这是一个旨在实现强有力的全球和地方控制的解决方案. 我们在四个控制设置(类、属性、前景和关键点)的结果表明,LisM方法,特别是Fit-Path,为全球和地方任务提供了有效、轻量级的控制,超过了噪声意识和像素空间指导。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Current vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINOv3 [ 42 ] and SigLIP 2 [ 50 ] present high generalizability to a wide range of tasks.
A defining property of these models is that they produce representations with strong linear readability [ 33 , 42 ] , so that single linear layers can be used to identify local and global attributes, and thus perform tasks such as classification and segmentation.
blocks.zh:
当前的愿景基础模型,如DINOv3[42]和SigLIP 2 [50] 对范围广泛的任务具有高度的概括性。
这些模型的一个定义属性是它们产生具有强烈的线性可读性[33,42]的表示,这样单线性地层就可以被用来识别局部和全局属性,从而完成分类和分化等任务.

blocks.en:
In recent years, VFMs are increasingly being incorporated into the generation process of generative models for accelerating training or improving generation quality.
Some relevant approaches include aligning intermediate states [ 60 , 24 ] , regularizing the variational autoencoder (VAE) tokenizer [ 55 ] , co-denoising [ 21 , 52 ] , or directly generating in representation space [ 63 , 48 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
近年来,VFM越来越多地被融入到加速培训或提高生产质量的基因模型的生成过程中.
某些相关做法包括:调整中间状态[60、24],使可变自编码器(VAE)指示器[55]规范化,共同识别[21、52],或在代表空间直接生成[63、48、43]。

blocks.en:
Beyond fidelity, another challenge of generation is control, i.e., guiding the model to fulfill semantic requests [ 14 , 62 ] .
The most common approach is training a conditional generator with paired data, but it limits conditions to those used for training.
To avoid this, post-hoc methods have been proposed.
Some of the most prominent train a noise-aware readout [ 8 , 27 ] , which requires retraining per condition.
Training-free alternatives apply off-the-shelf predictors to the decoded clean estimate [ 1 , 59 , 56 ] , but decode and backpropagate through the predictor and denoiser at every step.
Linear inverse solvers [ 51 , 45 , 4 ] need no readout network, but are mostly applied to pixel-level restoration.
blocks.zh:
除了忠诚之外,生成的另一个挑战是控制,即指导模型实现语义要求[14,62].
最常见的方法是培训一个附有对等数据的有条件的生成器,但它将培训使用的条件限制在培训使用的条件上。
为避免出现这种情况,提出了后荷克方法.
一些最突出的列车采用噪音感知读取[8,27],这需要每个条件的再培训.
无训练的替代品对已解码的清洁估计[1,59,56]适用现成的预测器,但在每个步骤上通过预测器和分解器解码并进行后置.
线性反向解析器 [51, 45, 4] 不需要读出网络,但大多应用于像素级还原.

blocks.en:
In this work, we ask whether the linear readability of VFMs can be exploited for guidance in generative models operating in the representation space, as linear inverse solvers do at the pixel level.
This would avoid per-condition retraining and decoding, while preserving generalizability.
Our key observation is that, in this space, a linear readout trained on clean data remains valid at every noise level.
The reason is as follows.
An ideal flow denoiser inherently predicts the posterior mean in any space. In the representation space, the semantic readout is linear, and a linear operator commutes with the expectation; thus, applying a linear probe, trained on clean data, to the denoiser’s prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the semantic scores (the probe outputs) at any noise level on the flow trajectory.
We call this regime Semantic Mean-Space .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们询问VFM的线性可读性是否可以像像像素级的线性反向解子一样在表现空间运行的基因模型中被利用来指导.
这将避免有条件的再培训和解码,同时保持普遍性。
我们的主要观察是,在这个空间中,经过清洁数据培训的线性读取在每一个噪音级别上仍然有效。
原因如下.
一个理想的流出者 内在的预言 任何空间的后期含义。 在表示空间中,语义读出是线性,线性操作员与预期通相通;因此,在Denoiser的预测中,用经过清洁数据培训的线性探测器得出流道上任何噪音水平的语义分数(探测输出)的准确后等值。
我们称这个政权为"语义中空"

blocks.en:
This regime opens up a new opportunity of how generative models can be guided at inference time.
In pixel or VAE spaces, a nonlinear readout does not commute with the expectation, so, applied to the clean prediction, it does not give the expected score that guidance needs to weight a request.
In Semantic Mean-Space, the linear probe does commute, and global attribute steering and dense spatial control naturally become Bayesian linear inverse problems, for which solvers such as DDNM [ 51 ] , Π \Pi GDM [ 45 ] , and DTMPD [ 4 ] provide lightweight, training-free conditioning.
blocks.zh:
这种制度为如何在推论时间指导基因模型开辟了新的机会。
在像素或VAE空格中,非线性读取不与预期通配,因此,应用到干净的预测中,它不会给出引导需要给请求加权的预期分数.
在语义平均空间中,线性探测器确实通勤了,而全球属性向导和密集的空间控制自然成为了贝叶斯的线性反向问题,对此,DDNM[51],QQ\Pi GDM[45]等解决器提供了轻量级,无训练条件.

blocks.en:
However, linear semantic guidance in a representation space
differs in a crucial way from restoration in pixel space: a linear probe measures only a low-dimensional projection of the feature tokens, leaving unprobed channels unconstrained.
Pushing a sample exclusively along the probe normal can easily satisfy the readout in latent space without producing the corresponding visual change after decoding.
We identify this failure mode as probe hacking .
blocks.zh:
然而,在表示空间中的线性语义指导
与像素空间中的还原有关键不同:线性探测器只测量地物符号的低维投影,使未铺设的通道不受限制.
将样本完全沿探测器正常运行,可以很容易地满足潜入空间的读取,而无需在解码后产生相应的视觉变化.
我们发现这个故障模式是探测器入侵

blocks.en: To understand what makes linear semantic guidance succeed, we propose a unified framework: Li near guidance in S emantic M ean-space ( LiSM ). Our main contributions are as follows: • We show that representation flows admit exact posterior-mean semantic readouts from clean linear probes, which turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, giving rise to LiSM. • We describe the LiSM framework along two axes, request weighting and representation response, and use it to adapt existing solvers and explore new solver design points. • We propose Fit-Path, a LiSM solver that achieves consistently strong performance across global and local tasks. • We evaluate different guidance frameworks on class, attribute, foreground, and keypoint control with an RAE generator, showing that the best LiSM solvers match or exceed pixel-space and noise-aware guidance in request adherence on all tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Representation-space generative models. Diffusion models typically operate in pixel space [ 15 , 32 ] or in the latent space of a reconstruction-oriented VAE [ 39 ] , whose features are poorly suited to linear readout [ 63 ] . Recent work brings pretrained representations into generation by aligning intermediate denoiser features with them [ 60 , 24 ] , regularizing the tokenizer [ 55 ] , jointly denoising images and representations [ 21 , 52 ] , or generating directly in the representation space of a frozen VFM [ 33 , 42 , 61 , 50 ] , as in RAE [ 63 ] , SVG [ 41 ] , Scale-RAE [ 48 ] , and RAEv2 [ 43 ] .
In such representation-space generators, the generated variable itself is linearly readable.
Representation readability has been used to select samples [ 48 ] and to edit conditioning embeddings [ 3 ] . Linear structure is also widely used to read and steer the internal activations of large language models [ 25 , 34 , 16 ] and diffusion models [ 22 , 5 , 47 ] .
However, to our knowledge, linear probes fitted on VFM features have not been used to guide sampling.
blocks.zh:
代表空间基因模型. 扩散模型通常在像素空间[15,32]或以重建为导向的VAE[39]的潜在空间中运行,其特征不适于线性读出[63]. 近期的工作将经过预先培训的表示方式引入一代人,办法是将中间的去极化特征与它们相接 [60, 24] ,使标语符号规范化 [55],联合去除图像和表示 [21, 52] ,或在被冻结的VFM [33, 42, 61, 50] 的表示空间直接生成,如RAE [63], SVG [41], Scale-RAE [48]和RAEv2 [43] 。
在这种表示-空间生成器中,生成的变量本身可线性读取.
已使用可读性来选择样本[48]并编辑配置嵌入 [3]. 线性结构也被广泛用于读取并引导大语言模型的内部活化[25,34,16]和扩散模型[22,5,47].
然而,据我们所知,没有使用安装在VFM特性上的线性探测器来指导取样。

blocks.en: Guidance with learned readouts. Training-time conditioning, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 14 ] and spatial adapters [ 62 , 31 , 26 ] , requires paired data and retraining for every new control modality. Inference-time guidance instead keeps the generator fixed and steers it with an external readout. Classifier Guidance (CG) [ 8 ] needs a classifier trained on inputs corrupted by the generator’s own noise process, so it is tied to that diffusion’s schedule and state space. Training-free methods reuse off-the-shelf predictors on the decoded clean estimate [ 59 , 1 , 56 ] , but every guided step decodes to pixels and backpropagates through both the predictor and the denoiser, which Universal Guidance (UG) repeats several times per step [ 1 ] . Such guidance is also unreliable on the unseen noisy estimates of early sampling [ 56 ] and prone to adversarial gradients [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 指导学习的阅读。 培训时间的调节,如无分级制导(CFG)[14]和空间适配器[62,31,26],需要配对数据和对每一个新的控制方式进行再培训. 推论时间制导转而保持发电机固定并用外接读取来引导. 分类指导(CG) [8] 需要一个对被生成器自身噪声过程所腐蚀的投入进行分级培训的分级器,因此它与该分级表和状态空间有关。 无训练方法在已解码的清洁估计上再用现成的预测器[59, 1, 56],但每个有导步骤解码到像素并通过预测器和分解器反向分解,通用指导(UG)每步重复了几次[1]. 这种指导对于早期采样的隐而不见的噪音估计也并不可靠[56],而且容易出现对抗梯度[40].

blocks.en:
Inverse-problem solvers and posterior approximations. Several solvers for inverse problems, with no need for an auxiliary network, were built for pixel-level restoration, differing mainly in how they approximate the clean posterior.
DPS [ 6 ] and AdamDPS [ 2 ] use a point mass at the clean estimate and backpropagate through the denoiser. DDiff [ 20 ] carries a dual variable and DCPS [ 17 ] runs inner variational and Langevin loops. Projection methods [ 19 , 51 , 66 ] enforce the linear constraint on the clean estimate.
In contrast, Gaussian moment solvers add a posterior covariance: isotropic in Π \Pi GDM [ 45 ] , DMPS [ 29 ] , and CoDPS [ 57 ] , estimated from denoiser Jacobians in DTMPD [ 4 ] , and initialized from data and updated online in Free Hunch [ 38 ] .
All target a measurement likelihood, mostly linear-Gaussian, rather than semantic requests.
Closer to our setting, for the special case of an exponential tilt of a linear readout, the exact conditional mean is obtained by evaluating the denoiser once at a shifted input [ 30 ] .
In Semantic Mean-Space , a clean linear probe acts as a linear operator on the denoiser output, without pixel decoding or readout backpropagation, so these solvers become applicable to semantic control.
Our LiSM framework adapts and unifies these solvers for representation flows along two axes: request weighting and representation response.

blocks.en: Guidance needs a correction of the clean prediction. Most methods obtain it by decoding the prediction and reading it with a pixel-space network, or by training a noise-aware readout. However, in a representation flow neither is needed: the generated variable is the representation itself, and a frozen encoder organizes it so that attributes are linearly readable. At the same time, at an intermediate step the clean prediction is not a clean sample but a posterior average of possible representations. Let r ⁡ ( z ) = W ​ z + b r(z)=Wz+b , with W ∈ ℝ m × d W\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d} and b ∈ ℝ m b\in\mathbb{R}^{m} , be a linear semantic probe fitted on clean representations and kept frozen. Our key observation is that it commutes with the posterior mean, so it reads the (ideal) denoiser’s output exactly, giving the posterior mean of the clean semantic scores at every noise level: r ⁡ ( 𝔼 ⁡ [ Z ∣ z t ] ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ r ⁡ ( Z ) ∣ z t ] . r(\mathbb{E}[Z\mid z_{t}])=\mathbb{E}[r(Z)\mid z_{t}]. (7) This follows from the linearity of conditional expectation. We call this regime Semantic Mean-Space ; it reduces semantic guidance to a problem on a few linear scores with known means, which linear inverse-problem solvers can handle. The identity requires the readout to be linear in z z (with bias), so we apply probes at the logit level.

5 Experiments

blocks.en:
We compared our novel LiSM framework to two other image-guidance frameworks: pixel-space [ 1 , 6 , 2 , 20 , 17 ] and noise-aware [ 8 , 2 ] .
Then, we explored the solver design space, identifying and implementing additional solvers, and compared configurations with different weightings and responses, including Path-Integral Responses (Path).
Complementarily, we ported existing solvers [ 17 , 6 , 2 , 4 , 45 , 20 , 38 , 57 ] to LiSM, and compared them against Fit-Path.
Finally, we evaluated the performance of Fit-Path using other VFMs beyond DINOv3 [ 42 ] : MAE [ 13 ] and SigLIP 2 [ 50 ] .
Additional analyses of Path are presented in Appendix B .

随后,我们探索了解析器设计空间,识别并执行了额外的解析器,并比较了配置与不同的加权和响应,包括路径-集成响应(Path).
作为补充,我们把现有的解析器[17,6,2,4,45,20,38,57]移植到LisM,并与Fit-Path进行比较.
最后,我们评价了Fit-Path在DINov3[42]以外使用其他VFM的性能:MAE [13]和SigLIP 2 [50].

blocks.en:
Unless stated otherwise, the experiments were performed on ImageNet [ 7 ] with RAEv2 [ 43 ] generator.
Specifically, we selected two global-level and two local-level guidance tasks to have a full view of the performance of different methods: class, image-level attributes, foreground and keypoints. For class, the denoiser receives the null class; for the other tasks, it is conditioned on the requested class with CFG scale 1. All methods share the same initial noise per request. We use 3,840 test requests in total; ablations use a fixed subset of 810.

Each task has an adherence and a preservation metric, both computed on decoded images by
external networks that differ from all guiding networks. Adherence is top-1 accuracy for class,
the fraction of images with a CLIP-based score above 0.1 for the requested attribute, IoU for
foreground, and PCK@0.2 for keypoints. Preservation is precision [ 23 ] for class and, for the other tasks, the rate at which an external classifier still recognizes the requested class.
We also report hacking (Hack), which is the mean over tasks of internal minus external adherence, clipped at zero per task, where internal adherence is measured by the guiding predictor on the final sample.

blocks.zh: 5.1 LiSM与其他指导框架

Table 1 shows the performance of the methods from different frameworks, including our LiSM solvers Fit-Id and Fit-Path, on the different evaluation tasks.
Both LiSM solvers use fitted Gaussian as weighting, but differ in the response: Fit-Id uses identity, while Fit-Path uses our proposed Path.
Qualitative examples of images generated by some of these methods are presented in Fig. 3 .
Full results for the different methods, with Adherence, Preservation, and Hacking are presented in Appendix D , while additional qualitative examples are shown in Appendix E .

blocks.en:
The performance of LiSM methods is overall superior to that of the Noise-aware and Pixel-space frameworks.
Across tasks, the best method in terms of geometric mean (GM) adherence is Fit-Path (87.2), followed by Fit-Id (79.5) and CG (72.1).
Fit-Path is also the method presenting the lowest hacking.
Interestingly, while Fit-Path provides the most balanced performance, Fit-Id performs particularly well on global tasks (Class and Attr.).
In general, the comparison to noise-aware methods shows that noise-aware training is not essential to representation space guidance, and linear probes with Semantic Mean-Space can produce very similar (e.g., the aircraft with trees in Fig. 3 ) or better images (e.g., the dog in the water).
blocks.zh:
LiSM方法的性能总体上优于噪声-意识和像素-空间框架.
在各项任务中,几何平均(GM)坚持率的最佳方法是Fit-Path(87.2),其次是Fit-Id(79.5)和CG(72.1)。
Fit-Path也是呈现最低黑客化的方法.
有趣的是,Fit-Path提供了最平衡的性能,而Fit-Id在全球任务(Class and Attr.)上的表现特别出色.
一般来说,与噪声感知方法的比较表明噪声感知训练对于表现空间取向来说并不重要,而带有语义平面空间的线性探测器可以产生非常相近的(如图3中有树的飞机)或更好的图像(如水中的狗).

blocks.en:
The improvements over pixel-space methods are even more pronounced, as they generally present much lower adherence than LiSM.
In addition, we observed that it is common, in methods such as DDiff, that the request is met but the image is not realistic (see Class, Fig. 3 ).
On the other hand, DCPS shows overall good image quality, but low adherence.
In contrast, LiSM generates highly natural and reasonable images, while still following the request.
blocks.zh:
对像素-空间方法的改进更为明显,因为这些方法的遵守程度一般比LisM低得多。
此外,我们还注意到,在DDIF等方法中,常见的是满足了请求,但图像不现实(见Class,图3.
另一方面,DCPS则显示总体图像质量良好,但遵守率较低.
相形之下,LisM生成了高度自然而合理的图像,同时仍然遵循请求.

blocks.en: 5.2 Analyzing the LiSM design space
blocks.zh: 5.2 分析LISM设计空间

blocks.en:
To better understand what makes linear semantic guidance succeed, we explored the design space of linear inverse-problem solvers.
The results of the different LiSM-adapted solvers on the four evaluated tasks are shown in Tab. 2 .
For clarity, we add references, in the table, to solvers already studied in previous works for pixel-space inverse problems.

blocks.en:
With an isotropic prior, the covariance response simply rescales the probe direction.
For a global probe on the mean token, the correction therefore shifts every patch by the same vector along that direction.
This uniform concept shift is consistent with the strong global adherence of Iso-Cov ( 94.0 94.0 ).
However, this same method fails on local tasks, with the lowest adherence (26.7).
In addition, for local tasks, the method presents high Hack: 72.2 for local vs. 5.9 for global (see Appendix D ).
This means that even though the method satisfies its own probe request in the representation, the image does not change.
These results suggest that isotropic scaling alone is insufficient for local tasks.
blocks.zh:
以同位素前置反应,同位素反应只是调整了探测器的方向.
对于平均符号上的全局探测器, 校正因此将每一个补丁 都沿着这个方向移动。
这种统一的概念转变符合伊索-科夫(94.0 94.0.
然而,同一方法在当地任务上失败,遵守率最低(26.7)。
此外,对于地方任务,该方法提出了高黑克:当地对全局5.9的72.2(见附录D)。
这意味着,即使该方法满足了自己在表示中的探测请求,图像也不会改变.
这些结果表明,单靠对地热带的扩张不足以执行当地的任务。

blocks.en:
Adding a Jacobian response of the denoiser (JVP/VJP), or an approximation of it (FD), notably improves adherence on local tasks (Iso: 26.7 → \,\to\, 71.4, Fit: 67.0 → \,\to\, 83.0), at the cost of largely reduced adherence on global ones (Iso: 94.0 → \,\to\, 50.0, Fit: 93.1 → \,\to\, 61.3).
Similar local adherence is observed for the three responses (JVP, VJP, FD) when using the same weighting, as shown for Fit (83.0–84.6 local, but only 58.1–64.5 global).
In line with these quantitative results, using denoiser responses generally improves the quality of images for local tasks.
Without it, Fit-Id produces unrealistic images, such as zebras with multiple extra legs for keypoint requests (see Appendix E ).
Thus, using the denoiser response is crucial for local tasks.
blocks.zh:
增加一个Jacobian反应(JVP/VJP),或近似(FD),显著改进了对当地任务的遵守(Iso:26.7 →\,\\,\\,71.4,适:67.0 →\,\\,83.0),代价是基本上减少了对全球任务的遵守(Iso:94.0 →\,\,\,50.0,适:93.1 →\,\,61.3).
三个答复(JVP、VJP、FD)在使用与Fit(83.0-84.6个当地,但只有58.1-64.5个全球)相同的加权时,也观察到类似的地方遵守。
根据这些量化结果,使用denoiser反应一般会提高图像质量,用于本地任务.
没有它,Fit-Id就会产生不切实际的图像,例如有多个多腿的斑马来进行键点请求(见附录E.
因此,利用Denoiser反应对当地的任务至关重要。

blocks.en:
The Path response heavily mitigates the low global adherence of denoiser responses, improving this metric for all weightings over VJP (Point: + 6.1 +6.1 percentage points [pp], Iso: + 36.8 +36.8 pp, Fit: + 32.3 +32.3 pp).
For Point and Iso, however, this improvement comes at the cost of lower adherence in local tasks (87.4 → \,\to\, 84.2 and 71.4 → \,\to\, 63.2, respectively).
For Fit, on the other hand, local adherence barely changes (83.0–84.6 → \,\to\, 83.2), while global adherence rises to 90.4 90.4 from at most 64.5 64.5 (FD).
Overall, GM adherence across tasks improves consistently with Path, with gains ranging from 1.7 pp (Point) to 16.6 pp (Fit).
The same holds for Hack, where Path variants present the lowest values by at least 7.9 pp.
We also noticed that under the same seed in local tasks, Fit-Path and Fit-FD often generate similar images, indicating that responses are nearly linear within the path range, something that does not happen for global tasks.
blocks.zh:
"路径"响应大大地缓解了德诺瓦斯反应在全球的遵守率低,改进了该度量衡对VJP上所有重心的分量(点:+ 6.1+ 6.1个百分点 [pp],伊索:+ 36.8+36.8页,Fit:+ 32.3+32.3页).
然而,对Point和Iso来说,这种改进的代价是当地任务的遵守程度较低(分别为87.4 ~ ,\ 和71.4 → 和63.2)。
另一方面,为了适应需要,当地遵守率几乎没有变化(83.0-84.6-\,\to\,83.2),而全球遵守率则从最多64.5 64.5 64.5(FD)上升到90.4 90.4。
总体而言,全球机制对各项任务的遵守程度与路径一致地提高,从1.7页(Point)到16.6页(Fit)不等。
Hack也是如此,Path变体至少以7.9pp表示最低值.
我们还注意到,在当地任务中的同种种子下,Fit-Path和Fit-FD经常生成相类似的图像,表明响应在路径范围内几乎是线性的,对于全球任务来说是不会发生的.

blocks.en:
In general, while identity and covariance give the best global adherence and denoiser responses the best local adherence, neither succeeds on both.
Among responses, Path represents the most balanced alternative, with the highest GM adherence for every weighting
and the best overall result with Fit, where local adherence is barely affected.
blocks.zh:
一般而言,虽然身份认同和共性使全球遵守最佳,而反响则使当地遵守最佳,但两者都未能成功。
在答复中,路径代表了最平衡的备选方案,每项权重都得到全球机制最高的遵守。
和最佳的总体结果 适, 当地遵守几乎没有受到影响。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with LiSM-adapted SOTA solvers
blocks.zh: 5.3 与适应LISM的SOTA解析器的比较

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 compares state-of-the-art solvers adapted to LiSM with our best Path-based method, Fit-Path, using the geometric-mean (GM) adherence and preservation over the four tasks.
Fit-Path lies at the top end of the Pareto frontier over preservation and adherence, with the highest adherence (87.2) at 5.7 × 5.7\times less time than DCPS, the next-best on adherence, which provides slightly higher preservation (+3.3 pp).
Interestingly, DDNM achieves marginally higher adherence than Control.
A detailed analysis reveals that this method presents a very high Hack value (72.4), largely satisfying its own probe requests without updating the image accordingly.
Overall, these results support the use of Fit-Path for both global and local guidance in Semantic Mean-Space.

图4将适应LISM的先进解析器与我们最好的基于路径的方法Fit-Path进行比较,在四项任务上采用几何-正(GM)的坚持和保存.
Fit-Path位于帕雷托边疆的顶端,高于保存和遵守,最高的遵守(87.2)比DCPS少了5.7×5.7\的时间,后者在遵守方面排行第二,提供了略高的保存(+3.3页)。
有趣的是,DDNM的遵守程度略高于控制。
详细分析显示,这种方法呈现出非常高的Hack值(72.4),在不相应更新图像的情况下,基本上满足了自己的探测请求.
总体而言,这些成果支持将Fit-Path用于语义平均空间的全球和地方指导。

blocks.en: 5.4 Generalization to other VFMs
blocks.zh: 5.4 向其他 VFM 通用

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
LiSM inherits the readability of the encoder, so attributes that linear probes cannot read cannot be requested, and transfer across encoders follows probe accuracy.
Fitting probes and covariance requires labeled clean features.
The Gaussian weighting assumes a Gaussian prior on representations, which is a coarse model of a class-clustered space, and strong global requests reduce preservation.
Finally, while Fit-Path successfully balances performance in global and local requests, there is no single solver that is best for all tasks.
Closing these gaps represents valuable future work.

相接探测器和相接性需要贴有标签的清洁特征.
高斯加权假设在表示前为高斯人,是类群空间的粗糙模型,强大的全球要求会减少保存.
最后,虽然Fit-Path成功平衡了全球和本地请求中的性能,但没有单一的解答器最适合所有任务.
弥合这些差距是未来的宝贵工作。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we proposed LiSM, a novel framework for training-free control of representation generators using linear probes.
Our work is founded on a simple but key observation: in representation flow models based on vision foundation models, such as RAE, a linear probe trained on clean data remains valid at every noise level, since it commutes with the posterior mean, so guidance becomes a Bayesian linear inverse problem.
With this, generation can be guided with any linear probe operating in the same representation space, such as a global class probe on the mean token or a per-patch probe for local control.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了LISM,这是使用线性探测器对表现式发电机进行免费培训控制的新框架.
我们的工作基于一个简单而关键的观察:在基于视觉基础模型的表达流模型中,如RAE,一个受过清洁数据训练的线性探测器在每一个噪声级别上仍然有效,因为它与后相通,所以指向成为了巴伊西亚线性反向问题.
有了这个方法,任何在同一代表空间运行的线性探测器都可以被引导出一代,例如平均信号上的全球级探测器或者用于局部控制的每平方位探测器.

blocks.en:
In our experiments, we have shown not only the overall suitability of the LiSM framework, but also its superior adherence over other state-of-the-art guidance frameworks such as pixel-space (e.g., DCPS) and noise-aware (e.g., CG) guidance.
Moreover, our systematic analysis of solvers showed that identity and covariance responses favor global tasks while denoiser responses favor local ones, and led to the proposal of Fit-Path, a LiSM solver that performs well on both with low probe hacking.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们不仅显示了LISM框架的总体适宜性,而且它比像素-空间(如DCPS)和噪声-知觉(如CG)等其他最先进的指导框架更优越的遵守.
此外,我们对解析器的系统分析表明,身份和共性反应有利于全球任务,而德克瓦泽反应则有利于地方任务,并导致Fit-Path的提议,这个LISM解析器在低探测器黑客化的情况下都表现良好。

blocks.en:
In conclusion, our framework offers a new and effective approach to lightweight and flexible control of representation generators.
Since LiSM relies only on frozen models and linear probes, we expect it to improve as vision foundation models and denoisers do.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们的框架为轻量级和灵活控制代表发电机提供了一种新的有效办法。
由于LISM只依靠被冻结的模型和线性探测器,我们期望它能像视觉基础模型和德诺瓦斯人那样得到改进.

blocks.en: LiSM can also take a text prompt as request. DINOv3 provides a text encoder E L E_{\mathrm{L}} aligned with an image encoder E V E_{\mathrm{V}} , trained with the dino.txt method [ 18 ] . E V E_{\mathrm{V}} is the same frozen DINOv3 backbone as our RAE encoder E E with a light vision head on top, so the two representations are closely related. Therefore, we simply bridge them by fitting a single linear layer on 50,000 ImageNet images without captions, that maps the pooled representation of E E , used for class and attributes guidance, to the embedding of E V E_{\mathrm{V}} , which is naturally also the space of E L E_{\mathrm{L}} . The similarity to the prompt embedding E L ​ ( prompt ) E_{\mathrm{L}}(\text{prompt}) is then a linear score on the representation, and we request that it exceeds a fixed threshold, using Fit-Path as before.

blocks.en: For the four task experiments we use the pretrained ImageNet RAEv2 model [ 43 ] with a DINOv3-L encoder, reconstruction decoder and DiT-DH-XL denoiser. Image resolution is 256 × 256 256\times 256 , with patch size 16 × 16 16\times 16 , forming a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid. The encoder, decoder, and denoiser remain frozen throughout our experiments. We follow the default RAEv2 sampling grid of 100 steps with time-shift factor 8. The base flow sampler uses Euler integration. We disable RAEv2’s internal guidance. For class guidance, the denoiser receives the null-class context so that the guidance method alone supplies the requested class. For attribute, foreground, and keypoint guidance, we condition the denoiser on the requested ImageNet class. Solvers are not guided at the first sampling step, where t = 1 t=1 and the correction scale c t = t 2 / ( 1 − t ) c_{t}=t^{2}/(1-t) is undefined. c t c_{t} remains very large in the steps that follow, so on our 100-step grid this leaves the first four steps unguided. For keypoints, the solvers are guided from the second step. All methods use the same initial Gaussian noise for each request–seed pair.

blocks.en: For each task, solvers within a guidance framework share the same predictor: a linear probe, a noise-aware predictor, or a pixel-space network. On each task’s support dataset, Table 6 reports both how well each predictor matches the annotations and how closely it agrees with the independent evaluator used to score generated images. We evaluate the noise-aware predictors at the clean endpoint t = 0 t=0 .

blocks.en: We evaluate generated images using two metrics, adherence and preservation, computed (after decoding) using the external networks shown in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用表6所示的外部网络计算(在解码后),使用两个衡量标准来评价生成的图像。

blocks.en: Adherence measures the fulfillment of the request. For class, we use the DeiT top-1 accuracy on the requested class. For attributes, we fit linear readouts for a CLIP vision encoder to align with attribute score, one linear layer per attribute. Then, we report the fraction of images whose score for the requested attribute exceeds 0.1. For foreground, we average the probability outputs of BiRefNet [ 64 ] within each patch and mark a cell as foreground if its mean exceeds 0.2 0.2 . We report mean intersection over union (IoU) with the requested mask on the 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid. For keypoints, we report the percentage of correct keypoints (PCK@0.2). A visible joint is correct if HRNet [ 46 ] predicts it within 20 % 20\% of the longer side of the target bounding box with a confidence of at least 0.2 0.2 . We average over visible joints within each image, and then over images.
blocks.zh: 遵守措施满足要求。 对于班级,我们在要求的班级上使用DEiT上1的精度. 对于属性,我们对一个CLIP视觉编码器进行线性读取以配合属性分数,每个属性一个线性分层. 然后,我们报告部分图像的得分 超过要求的属性。 前景,我们平均BiRefNet[64]在每个补丁内的概率输出,如果单元格的平均值超过0.2 0.2,则将单元格标为前景。 我们报告是指在联合体(IoU)上与要求的口罩相接, 关于关键点,我们报告正确关键点的百分比(PCK@02)。 如果HRNet[46]预测在目标边框较长一面的20%至20%以内,且置信度至少为0.2 0.2,则可见关节是正确的. 我们平均在每一幅图像的可见关节上,然后在图像上。

blocks.en: Preservation measures if the generated image is still a valid sample. For class guidance, we use precision [ 23 ] : the fraction of generated images whose features are considered within the reference distribution, which we calculate from a support set of 46,000 images from ImageNet. For the other three tasks, we use the class top-1 accuracy as preservation.
blocks.zh: 如果生成的图像仍然是有效的样本,则采取保全措施。 对于班级指导,我们使用精度[23]: 其特性在参考分布中被考虑的生成图像的一小部分,我们从ImageNet的由46,000个图像组成的支持集中计算出来。 对于其他三项任务,我们使用类上一精度作为保存.

blocks.en: For each solver with a tunable guidance strength, we sweep candidate values separately for each task on a fixed development set. For class guidance, we select the strength with the highest DeiT top-1 accuracy on the requested class. For the other three tasks, we select the highest task adherence among candidates that have at least 75% class preservation. The selection scores are the fitted CLIP score for attributes, mask IoU for foreground, and PCK@0.2 for keypoints. We fix the selected strengths before test evaluation. Experiments were run on NVIDIA A100 and GeForce RTX 5080 GPUs. Runtime was measured in a separate run on the former device.
blocks.zh: 对于每个具有可捕性指导力的解答者,我们将每项任务的候选值分别划入固定的开发集. 对于班级指导,我们在所请求的班级上以最高的DEiT顶一精度选择出强度. 对于其他三项任务,我们从至少保留了75%等级的考生中挑选出最高的任务遵守率. 选取分数为属性的装配CLIP分数,前置口罩IoU分数,键入分数为PCK@0.2. 在测试评价前我们先确定选定的优势。 在NVIDIA A100和GeForce RTX 5080 GPU上进行了实验. 运行时间在前一个设备上的单独运行中被测量.

blocks.en:
For Class , we request every ImageNet class, with the generator under the null class label. The development set uses 100 randomly drawn classes, and the ablation subset uses 200 classes drawn at random from the remaining 900. For Attributes , we use seven scene attributes from SUN Attributes [ 35 ] and pair each of them with
randomly drawn ImageNet classes that span animals and vehicles. We do not
require a pair to co-occur in real images, so the set contains both common
pairs, such as a hartebeest on grass, and unusual ones, such as a motor scooter
on the ocean.
For Foreground , we randomly draw ImageNet classes from PartImageNet [ 11 ] and use the annotated object masks of real images as requests. Every class receives a mask from an image of the same class ( within-class ), which the generator can plausibly produce, and a mask transferred from another class. The transferred mask comes either from a class of the same super-category ( within-category ), such as another quadruped, or from a different super-category ( cross-category ), which asks for a shape that the class rarely takes.
For Keypoints , we use animal species that are in both AP-10K [ 58 ] and ImageNet, and draw real
poses from AP-10K as requests. Every pose is requested once with its own
species ( within-species ) and once with another species
( cross-species ), without adapting the pose to the new body proportions.
